content: Lc0 (LeelaChessZero/lc0): Metal backend is the DEFAULT on macOS builds (faster than OpenCL, supports newer nets). Install via 'brew install lc0' or binaries from lczero.org/play/download. Needs a network weights file. Optional superhuman sparring/analysis opponent (AlphaZero-style MCTS engine — used only as an opponent, NOT as ANCE's paradigm).
